## `pygeovision.data.radiometric`

pygeovision.data.radiometric ============================== Real, documented sensor identification, radiometric scaling (raw DN -> physical reflectance), and cloud/shadow masking for Landsat and Sentinel-2 optical imagery.

| Name | Kind | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `landsat_mission_aliases` | function | Real, per-mission Landsat band aliases, or None if scene_id isn't a recognised Landsat mission prefix. |
| `identify_sensor` | function | Positively identify Landsat vs Sentinel-2 from a scene ID. |
| `sentinel2_boa_add_offset` | function | DN offset to subtract before dividing by 10000 for a Sentinel-2 L2A scene. |
| `dn_to_reflectance` | function | Raw digital numbers -> surface reflectance (float32, 0-1), NaN where no data. |
| `stack_and_prepare_bands` | function | Build a real, correctly-ordered, radiometrically-correct, cloud-masked multi-band GeoTIFF from a set of single-band asset files (e.g. Sentinel-2's separate… |
| `footprint_path` | function | The data-footprint raster of a stacked scene, in a ``footprints`` folder beside it (1 = data there). |
| `crop_to_bbox` | function | Crop a raster to a real WGS84 bounding box. |
| `real_pixel_area_ha` | function | Real, geodesically-accurate per-pixel area in hectares. |

## `pygeovision.data.ai_prep`

pygeovision.data.ai_prep ========================= AI readiness layer — the bridge between pygeofetch processed rasters and pygeovision foundation model inference.

| Name | Kind | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `fix_georeference` | function | Fix identity-transform CRS corruption on pygeofetch GRD downloads. |
